newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to follow Islamic group's stand on Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to follow Islamic group's stand on Afghanistan.

text.p: Bangladesh would follow the decision of the Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) about according recognition to the Taleban government in Afghanistan, foreign ministry officials said on Wednesday.
"We are closely watching the developments in Afghanistan. We are waiting for OIC's decision (in recognising the Taleban government)," one official told reporters.

Influential OIC members Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates have already recognised the fundamentalist Islamic Taleban militia, which overpowered troops loyal to ousted President Burhanuddin Rabbani earlier this week to take almost full control of Afghanistan.
"But we are still watching how other OIC members, Iran in particular, respond," said the official who declined to be identified.
